maria (prod): quick WG to lock down enterprise compliance roadmap items: audit streams, BYOK/KMS, legal-hold, SOC2 bundles. target: pilot-ready for Dedicated in ~3 months.
kevin (eng): agree. recommend split: M1 audit append-only + signed manifests, M2 BYOK onboarding + preflight, M3 export + legal-hold, M4 SOC2 packaging.
ashley (security): acceptance must include tamper-evidence v1 (signed manifests) and v2 (merkle/attestation). BYOK: no plaintext keys, clear key policy.
samir (ops): ops needs runbooks for evidence export, archive lifecycle, and cost model before SLA commits. preflight automation required.
dara (legal): exports need chain-of-custody fields (requestor, auth, checksum, export TTL). add tamper-evidence contract clause.
maria (prod): product proposal: per-tenant retention tiers (30d/1y/7y) configurable; per-route later. legal-hold pins events to long-term storage.
kevin (eng): implementation note: support two BYOK modes: delegated KMS calls (A) and envelope-with-HSM escrow (B). default A for self-serve, B for regulated pilots. will stub kms-preflight API.
nashley (security): require monitoring for anomalous export activity; include export alerts in runbooks.
samir (ops): will add anomaly alerts to SIEM playbooks.
maria (prod): action items: kevin PRD M1 (Tue), ashley security matrix (Wed), samir runbook + cost (Wed), dara draft clause (Fri). WG check next Thu 11am PT. :thumbsup: ?
